top_choice_rationale: P001 most compellingly joins a mature fundamental physiological discovery to broad, established therapeutic transformation in diabetes and obesity. Its focused citation and proposed trio remain defensible provided they distinguish enabling GLP-1 physiology from later drug optimization and industrial development.
recusal_note: The profile records a 2009 co-authored paper with committee member Thomas Perlmann; no documented connection to a proposed laureate or achievement is apparent.
